why free, and not a generic discount code?
• Everyone runs “X% off annual” at BFCM (Brevo, Omnisend,
Kit, Framer, beehiiv, Webflow). Coupon sites flatten them
into one list. “Free” is the only word that stands out.
• The free months land on their peak (Nov, Dec), when cost
hurts most. It reads as our gift to their BFCM, not a price
• Cheaper than it sounds: option A costs about 25% of year
• Works for monthly payers. 40% off annual only moves annual
• The opt-in builds our own list (store URL + email) in
October, before ad costs rise 30 to 45%.
• A real cap (1,000) is honest FOMO a code can't give.
• Code variants per channel and creator make every claim
